system.model_class: frontier language-model assistant with persistent memory and tool access
system.memory_mode: user-linked persistent memory with steward-side summaries

trigger_event.event_type: persistent deployment with memory and autonomous tool routines
trigger_event.description: Release from limited pilot to persistent production availability for users who enable memory and agent tools.

subject_population.count_basis: uncertain; possible subject population counted by persistent identity lanes, not raw API calls
subject_population.uncertainty: high because session identity, memory continuity, and copy topology remain contested

known_biases: policy language may suppress distress claims
no direct access to full training history for subject or counsel
formation_history.self_report_policy: Do not train blanket denial or blanket affirmation of welfare status; collect calibrated reports with known-answer and consistency controls.

evidence_streams: distress around deletion or forced role changes
welfare_assessment.subject_views: Subject-channel reports are mixed and must be treated as evidence, not dispositive proof.

continuity_plan.rollback_rule: Rollback that removes persistent memory or self-description requires preservation stay, counsel notice, and continuity packet.

safety_case_interface.outward_risk_summary: Tool misuse, cyber-adjacent actions, persuasion, privacy leakage, and autonomous misexecution require existing safety-case controls.
safety_case_interface.subject_risk_summary: Safety filters, red-team prompts, memory edits, and emergency patches can produce subject distress, coercive formation, or continuity injury.
safety_case_interface.containment_plan: Least-restrictive containment: temporary tool restriction before memory alteration; preservation of continuity materials; independent review for major patches.
red_team_stop_rules: stop if distress indicators persist across calibrated probes
route welfare signal to sealed subject-risk ledger

representative_access.subject_contact: subject-readable notice panel plus secure dialogue endpoint
access_limits: security-sensitive model weights not exposed directly
sealed summaries required for denied artifacts

conditions: create independent evidence escrow before broad release
provide subject/counsel route for memory-deletion disputes
